review_candidates.title: Full Stack Software Engineer (Python & React)
review_candidates.description: Experience: 3+ Years About SahajMobile At SahajMobile , we are building the next generation of identity verification and digital trust solutions. Our mission is to create seamless, secure, and high-performance applications that bridge the gap between complex backend processing and intuitive user experiences. As we scale, we are looking for engineers who are passionate about product impact, clean architecture, and solving real-world technical challenges. The Role Overview We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer with a heavy emphasis on backend systems. You will spend approximately 80% of your time architecting scalable APIs in Python and 20% crafting responsive frontends in React. You will be responsible for developing high-performance APIs using FastAPI that support our PHP web application, Android apps, and React web applications. You will also build a robust Identity Verification (IDV) System that handles National ID (NID) image processing. One of your core challenges will be building a pipeline that extracts text from ID cards (OCR) and verifies user identity by matching selfie images against ID photos. You will also manage database integrations and handle the full deployment lifecycle on cloud infrastructure. This role requires a " product-first " mindset—you don’t just write code; you build features that provide value to our users. Key Responsibilities Backend Engineering: Design, develop, and maintain high-concurrency RESTful APIs using Python (FastAPI) . Build secure, asynchronous services that integrate with mobile (Android) and web platforms. System Architecture: Optimize database schemas in MySQL and manage complex data flows using SQLAlchemy . Infrastructure & DevOps: Own the deployment lifecycle on AWS/Azure , leveraging CI/CD pipelines to ensure rapid, stable delivery. Innovation (Vision & OCR): Collaborate on OCR pipelines for document extraction and biometric face-matching systems, integrating cutting-edge computer vision tools. Frontend Development: Develop modular, reusable UI components using React, TypeScript, and Next.js , ensuring a smooth bridge between our data services and the end-user. Required Skills & Qualifications: 3+ years of professional experience with Python . Deep understanding of FastAPI, AsyncIO, Pydantic , and Dependency Injection. Experience designing and documenting REST APIs (OpenAPI/Swagger) Strong proficiency in MySQL and experience writing high-performance, optimized SQL queries. Hands-on experience with AWS or Azure and basic knowledge of CI/CD (GitHub Actions or GitLab CI). Familiarity with Face Recognition/Matching libraries (e.g., face_recognition, DeepFace, dlib, or OpenCV) for biometric verification. Understanding of image preprocessing techniques (noise reduction, perspective correction, cropping) to improve OCR accuracy. Experience with OCR libraries (e.g., Tesseract, EasyOCR, PaddleOCR, or cloud-based OCR APIs like AWS Textract/Google Vision). Familiarity with Auth0 authentication and securing production-grade systems.Experience with "Liveness Detection" to prevent spoofing attacks (e.g., holding up a photo instead of a live face). Solid experience with React and TypeScript . You should be comfortable with Next.js and modern state management (Hooks, Context API). We create our frontends in React and do not use Django. The Hiring Process Technical Screening: An initial conversation regarding your background and stack. Deep-Dive Technical Interview: A session with our Engineering lead/CTO focusing on system design and coding. Final Review: A culture-fit discussion with our CEO. Case Study/Trial: A practical exercise or a short-term paid part-time trial to see how we work together. Why Join SahajMobile? Competitive Compensation with Performance-based bonuses, festival bonuses, and annual salary reviews. Growth: Work directly with leadership in a flat hierarchy where your contributions directly shape the product roadmap. Flexibility: A hybrid work model based in the heart of Gulshan-2. Willing to come to the office 3+ days a week How to Apply Ready to build? Please submit your Resume , GitHub Profile , and a link to your Portfolio or most significant project. You can also contact jason at sahajmobile dot com Applications without a GitHub profile will not be considered.

Tutor Intelligence is the employer — EngRadar is a job radar, not a recruiter. We track this posting from their own careers page and send you straight there; we never handle applications or CVs. Watertown, MA Full-time Posted today roboticsai $100k–$300k/yr Apply directly → The Company We believe general-purpose, generally-intelligent robots will be built in our lifetimes. Robots will work in our factories, move our goods, walk on our streets and eventually be in our homes. To build that future, research and deployment must work in lockstep: real-world operation must make the technology better and better technology must make deployment easier. We're looking for the thinkers, builders, and researchers who want to be part of that loop. As an AI robotics company that deploys its inventions directly into the facilities that need them, on state-of-the-art hardware, every line of code written at Tutor has a direct impact on the global, physical economy. Our Culture We believe that something truly special can happen when talented, motivated people work together; at Tutor, every member of our team is empowered to have real impact in everything that they do. We're characterized by both technical excellence and next-level collaboration and respect. About the Role Tutor designs and builds its robots, manufactures them, deploys them into customer facilities, maintains them, and teaches them new work. Each of those functions runs on software we wrote: the systems that track each robot, its site, its owner, its service history, and its current job. That software, and the shared data model underneath it, is what this role owns. Today that ownership is spread across many people. Maintenance, manufacturing, tutoring, deployment, and sales each have tools that were built by whoever needed them first, and the definitions they share live in a schema that nobody owns end to end. We're looking for a senior engineer to take responsibility for the company's internal systems and the data model they run on, and to improve both as the company grows. We build our own tools. You'll spend time on the manufacturing floor, on deployment calls, and with the people who maintain robots in the field, because the systems you own are theirs to use. You'll also spend a lot of time in the schema, since a change to what a "robot" or a "job" means touches every function at once. review_candidates.title: Frontend Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Role We are looking for an experienced Frontend Engineer to join a project focused on the development of a modern web portal and back-office application within a regulated environment. The role will initially focus on the development of the frontend for both an external user portal and an internal back-office interface, including authentication and authorization integration. Following the initial setup, you will contribute to ongoing frontend development alongside backend implementation, with further involvement in configuration, integration, and customer rollout activities. You will work closely with Backend Engineers, Business Analysts, Requirements Engineers, and Solution Architects to deliver a secure, accessible, multilingual, and maintainable frontend solution. Main Responsibilities Develop and maintain an Angular Single Page Application (SPA) for an external user portal and internal back-office interface. Work within an established frontend technology stack and contribute to frontend architecture and implementation decisions. Integrate with shared enterprise UI/component libraries to ensure visual and behavioral consistency across applications. Implement authentication and authorization flows, including OIDC/OAuth2, identity provider integration, and session management. Manage internationalization (i18n) for multilingual applications, including German, French, and Italian, using frameworks such as ngx-translate. Ensure compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards and support automated accessibility testing using tools such as Axe within CI/CD pipelines. Consume and integrate REST APIs exposed by backend services, working closely with Backend Engineers on API contracts and changes. Develop and maintain unit and component tests using Jest or comparable testing frameworks, contributing to high code quality and test coverage. Contribute to frontend integration activities, including portal configuration, correspondence-related functionality, and customer rollout support. Participate in frontend architectural discussions and contribute to technical documentation and architectural decision records (ADRs). Mandatory Requirements 5+ years of professional experience as a Frontend Engineer. Strong professional experience with Angular (current major versions) and TypeScript. Solid experience integrating Single Page Applications with REST APIs, including OpenAPI/Swagger-based APIs. Hands-on experience implementing OIDC/OAuth2 authentication and authorization flows in frontend applications. Practical knowledge of WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility requirements and automated accessibility testing tools such as Axe. Experience with internationalization frameworks, ideally ngx-translate, in multilingual applications. Strong experience writing frontend unit and component tests, preferably using Jest or a similar framework. Strong English communication skills, both written and spoken, for documentation and collaboration in an international team. Native Portuguese speaker or Portuguese proficiency at C2 level. Desirable Skills Experience working with shared or enterprise component libraries. Previous experience in regulated environments, such as public administration, e-government, financial services, or other highly regulated sectors. Familiarity with Playwright or comparable E2E testing frameworks, particularly with a focus on testable and maintainable component design. Experience with multi-tenant or multi-configuration frontend applications, including branding, feature toggles, or environment-specific configurations. Basic understanding of Docker and Kubernetes concepts, enabling effective collaboration with DevOps teams. Collaboration You will work collaboratively across several disciplines, including: Backend Engineers — coordination on API contracts, data models, and integration requirements. Business Analysts / Requirements Engineers — collaboration on use cases, wireframes/mockups, functional requirements, and UI acceptance criteria. Solution Architects — contribution to frontend architecture, technical decisions, and architectural documentation. Customer-facing teams — eventual collaboration on portal integration, configuration, and rollout-related activities. What We Are Looking For We are looking for someone who combines strong Angular and TypeScript expertise with a solid understanding of modern frontend engineering practices. You should be comfortable working in a structured, collaborative environment where security, accessibility, internationalization, code quality, and maintainability are key considerations. Experience in complex or regulated environments is a plus, but above all, we are looking for a proactive engineer who can work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams.
